messages:
sara_cs: Hey team — AcmeCorp returned the vendor risk form and DPA questions. Major asks: SOC2 scope confirmation, production-only data residency (they want EU-only), and BYOK for embeddings. They flagged this as a dependency for renewal in 3 weeks. Attaching their filled form (link).

lisa_legal: Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes: our standard DPA supports EU residency via region config but BYOK is treated as an addendum (we've done this once with a partner). Need legal review time ~3-5 business days.

dan_security: For SOC2 scope — we can provide the sections that cover hosted API and Dedicated, but Private (on-prem) requests need separate attestation. Do we know if Acme is on Hosted or Dedicated today?

sara_cs: They're on Hosted API (paid, heavy usage). Renewal contingent on confirming EU residency + BYOK timeline. They asked if we can commit before renewal.

michael_eng: Technical feasibility: EU-only data residency can be enforced at routing level and we can pin their tenant to eu-west region. BYOK for embeddings: we have a BYOK flow for keys in our KMS integration but embeddings key-wrap + HSM attestation would need ops/infra time. Estimate: 2-3 weeks to validate and rollout to their tenant if no infra blockers.

dan_security: If we do BYOK, we'll need a security review and to capture key provenance. Also need to document that model artifacts are not synced to any external logs. I'll draft a checklist.

lisa_legal: From legal side, if we ship BYOK as an add-on there are some standard clauses around key control and limited support. I'll start an addendum draft. If engineering needs sample language: ``Customer is sole owner of encryption keys and Redwood has zero access to plaintext or key material; customer must use supported KMS.``

sara_cs: Ok can we pull this into a short ops plan and assign owners? Acme wants an answer within 5 business days. Renewal escalates if we miss that.

onboarding-bot: TASKS: @michael_eng - confirm region pin feasibility and ETA. @dan_security - produce BYOK security checklist. @lisa_legal - draft BYOK DPA addendum. @sara_cs - coordinate customer expectation and send timeframe.

michael_eng: I'll validate region pin today and post the config snippet. If approved, we can schedule tenant pinning during a low-traffic window. ETA: 48 hours for confirmation, 10 business days for full rollout with smoke tests.

dan_security: I'll have the checklist by EOD tomorrow. It will include key provenance items, audit log requirements, and integration acceptance tests.

lisa_legal: Addendum draft by end of week. If we need faster, I can do a minimal terms email for initial sign-off.

sara_cs: Great — I'm telling Acme: tentative plan = EU residency + BYOK possible; final timeline after internal confirmations (48h for region, EOD tomorrow for sec checklist, addendum by Fri). I'll ask them to pause renewal pressure until next sync and loop in their legal ops.

michael_eng: Pasting the example region pin command for ops:
```
# pin tenant to eu-west
redwood tenant update --id acme-prod --region eu-west-1 --force
```

dan_security: One more, @sara_cs — please collect the customer's required KMS provider (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) and any existing compliance docs so we can map acceptance criteria.

sara_cs: Noted. I'll ask them now and report back in this thread. :+1:
